description: This file contains internal utility functions for handling Unicode strings in the PDFsharp library, including conversion between UTF-16 and UTF-32, dealing with surrogate pairs, and symbol code point remapping.

classes.name: UnicodeHelper
classes.description: A static internal utility class providing methods for Unicode string processing, surrogate pair handling, and code point conversions within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: Utf32FromString
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string into an array of Unicode code points, handling surrogate pairs and optional ANSI coercion.

methods.name: SymbolCodePointsFromString
methods.description: Converts a string into symbol code points using an OpenTypeDescriptor's remapping.

methods.name: ConvertToUtf32
methods.description: Converts a surrogate pair to a UTF-32 code point, returning 0 if invalid.

methods.name: IsInRange
methods.description: Checks if a character falls within a specified Unicode range.
